historical_record.description: The general manager told the Recreation and Park Commission that Mission Playground needed rehabilitation, some of its equipment dating from 1934, and that Foremost-McKesson had given $10,000 through the Friends of Recreation and Parks, to be matched by federal funds; Hubert Schmidt, landscape architect of the Department of Public Works, showed a schematic design.
